purpose: Topic-indexed downstream routing of verified Nathan-authored material into theory/formalization/solver work without confusing provenance with theory authority.

items.title: Geometry as a way to approach unfamiliar physics
items.why_useful: Supports geometry-first reconstruction methodology without treating assistant formalization as the source of intent.
items.currentness_caution: Method/provenance statement; not by itself a theory equation or validation claim.

items.title: Early vocabulary: timesheet and world line
items.why_useful: Prevents later vocabulary from being projected backward onto the original dimensional construction and helps distinguish worldline/filament/worldtube/timesheet genealogy.
items.currentness_caution: Historical vocabulary provenance; later usage is sharper.

items.title: θ4 terminology changed with the model
items.why_useful: Explicit Nathan instruction that major definitions/naming conventions can change over time and should remain dated rather than flattened into a single timeless definition.
items.currentness_caution: Do not read either historical θ4 phrase as the current formal definition merely because it is quoted.

items.title: Electron, quark braids, and true bosons
items.why_useful: Provides direct Nathan correction for interpreting older particle-strand documents and identifies long-lived intended distinctions that should be checked against later worldtube/finite-core work.
items.currentness_caution: Requires later-worldtube/finite-core crosslink before being treated as current theory; feed status deliberately below THEORIST_READY for current-model use.

items.title: Start with a helix, a straight line, and an intersecting plane
items.why_useful: Earliest currently identified raw construction conversation in the compendium and a natural clean-sheet source for reconstructing the helix/intersection geometry genealogy.
items.currentness_caution: Historical pre-SAT vocabulary; requires later-correction/context crosswalk before direct current-theory use.
